entries.title: Isaiah 47:1
segments: ¶Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: [there is] no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

entries.title: Isaiah 47:2
segments: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.

entries.title: Isaiah 47:3
segments: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet [thee as] a man.

entries.title: Isaiah 47:4
segments: [As for] our redeemer, the LORD of hosts [is] his name, the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 47:5
segments: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

entries.title: Isaiah 47:6
segments: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

entries.title: Isaiah 47:7
segments: ¶And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: [so] that thou didst not lay these [things] to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.

entries.title: Isaiah 47:8
segments: Therefore hear now this, [thou that art] given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I [am], and none else beside me; I shall not sit [as] a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

words.text: now this, [thou that art] given to pleasures
beside me; I shall not sit

entries.title: Isaiah 47:9
segments: But these two [things] shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, [and] for the great abundance of thine enchantments.

entries.title: Isaiah 47:10
segments: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I [am], and none else beside me. {perverted...: or, caused thee to turn away}

words.text: beside me. {perverted...: or, caused thee to turn away}

entries.title: Isaiah 47:11
segments: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, [which] thou shalt not know. {from...: Heb. the morning thereof} {put: Heb. expiate}

words.text: upon thee; thou shalt not know
upon thee; thou shalt not be able
. {from...: Heb. the morning thereof} {put: Heb. expiate}

entries.title: Isaiah 47:12
segments: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

words.text: ; if so be thou shalt be able
, if so be thou mayest prevail

entries.title: Isaiah 47:13
segments: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from [these things] that shall come upon thee. {astrologers: Heb. viewers of the heavens} {the monthly...: Heb. that give knowledge concerning the months}

words.text: thee from [these things] that shall come
upon thee. {astrologers: Heb. viewers of the heavens} {the monthly...: Heb. that give knowledge concerning the months}

entries.title: Isaiah 47:14
segments: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: [there shall] not [be] a coal to warm at, [nor] fire to sit before it. {themselves: Heb. their souls}

words.text: Behold, they shall be as stubble

entries.title: Isaiah 47:15
segments: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, [even] thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.

words.text: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured
